about: Edition includes: • Ghost of Yōtei™ Complete Edition • Echoes of Sekigahara¹, a new story expansion • Most Wanted¹, a combat survival mode • In-game Mask • Charm of Hokkyokusei • The Snake Armor • Digital Deluxe Armor Dye •…

• Charm of Amaterasu Set aside the order of the Edo period in this definitive release of Ghost of Yōtei™. The Echoes of Sekigahara and Most Wanted in-game content will be included as part of an update (patch v.2.0).

This standalone experience follows Atsu, a haunted and lone mercenary, as she sets out to hunt down those who killed her family many years prior. Her quest across Ezo takes her to unexplored lands as she seeks out a gang of six outlaws.
Along the way, help her find unlikely allies, forge lasting bonds and build a path towards healing and redemption.
Engage in fluid and dynamic combat, go beyond the bloodshed and piece together Atsu’s unconventional tale living at the periphery of 1600s Northern Japan, obscured by the shadows of Mount Yōtei.

Included in this version: Echoes of Sekigahara• • Delve into a new story expansion into Atsu’s past, explore a whole new area of Ezo, learn more of the Battle of Sekigahara and master a type of new weapon in combat.
